name: Harshdeep Hortico Ltd
title: Harshdeep Hortico Ltd - 544105 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue of about INR 69 crore missed the INR 85 crore expectation as LPG cuts and a 20-25% raw-material spike hit output, though management still guides 25-30% growth if conditions normalise.

utilisation.quote: I would say that we are comfortable to do at least 35-40% growth from the current infrastructure

capex.quote: Sir, currently, we are quite comfortable with the CapEx. And if there will be anything, then, of course, we'll discuss.

triggers.label: Inventory up 62%, receivables up 51%
triggers.quote: The inventories in our books have gone up by 62%, and our receivables are up 51%.

triggers.label: FY27 guide INR 115 cr vs FY26 INR 69 cr
triggers.quote: for FY27, the guidance was INR 115 crore

triggers.label: Raw material up 60%, price hike ~25%
triggers.quote: the prices of the raw material has been hiked by 60%

triggers.label: 10% of facility affected by LPG and inputs
triggers.quote: I would say 10% of our facility has been affected because of all the regulations.

guidance.value: 25-30% a year if geopolitical conditions normalise
guidance.quote: we are surely positive on 25-30% of growth every year that we can see, which is realistic.
